subject: Handoff: MedSync Health — Welcome strategy & owner assignment
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Derek Shaw <derek.shaw@medsync.co>, Emily Ruan <emily.ruan@medsync.co>
Date: Thu, Feb 26, 2026 at 09:12 AM PST
Subject: Handoff: MedSync Health — Welcome strategy & owner assignment

Hi team,

Quick handoff note for MedSync Health (closed last week, committed Redwood Dedicated + hosted fallbacks; ~ $360k ARR committed). Key facts up-front:
- Primary outcome: deploy Redwood Dedicated in their Azure tenancy, 3-month onboarding with training, runbook, and production cutover.
- SLA/expectation: <100ms median generation for baseline workload, weekly quality checks for first 30 days.
- Procurement: contracts@medsync.co is handling SOW signature; expect redlines by EOD Monday.

Attached: MedSync_SOW_v1.pdf (sales draft) and initial task list. Ask: please assign CS owner and confirm target kickoff window (we told them week of Mar 1 - Mar 8).

Notes for whoever takes ownership:
- Account champion: Derek Shaw (VP Product) — primary technical contact is Emily Ruan (lead engineer).
- Integration: they want our private deployment in Azure (VNET peering) + one-time dataset migration (~120GB).
- Compliance: they asked for audit logs and SOC2 evidence (we have the packet; will share separately if needed).

Marcus, sharing any outstanding contract expectations not in the SOW? Monica/Lauren/Vivek, can you confirm owner assignment and a proposed kickoff date?

Thanks,
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0132

Attachments: MedSync_SOW_v1.pdf, MedSync_Onboarding_Tasks.csv
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Derek Shaw <derek.shaw@medsync.co>, contracts@medsync.co
Date: Thu, Feb 26, 2026 at 11:03 AM PST
Subject: Re: Handoff: MedSync Health — Welcome strategy & owner assignment

Thanks Jasmine — appreciate the concise summary. A couple quick clarifying Qs before we lock owner: 
1) Training cadence: do they want a train-the-trainer model or direct sessions for engineers + ops? (I can prepare both outlines).
2) Compliance ask: Emily mentioned SOC2 evidence — I'll pull the standard packet, but do we need a custom statement for data residency?

Also Marcus, can you confirm if there's any billing milestone we should reflect in the onboarding calendar (e.g., invoice on provision vs 30 days after signature)? Putting those dates in the plan helps CS schedule checkpoints.

I'll volunteer to coordinate kickoff logistics if Lauren wants to own the account delivery.

—Monica
Monica Patel
Manager, Customer Success | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwoodinference.com

Date: Fri, Feb 27, 2026 at 08:22 AM PST
Subject: Re: Handoff: MedSync Health — Welcome strategy & owner assignment

Happy to take ownership of the account. Draft 30/60/90 plan below — feel free to flag anything missing:

30 days (discover & prep):
- Kickoff & goals alignment (schedule with Derek + Emily)
- Access collection: API keys, network allowlist, service accounts, sample dataset delivery
- Walkthrough of SOW deliverables and success metrics

60 days (integration & validation):
- Deploy Dedicated environment in customer Azure tenancy (coordinate with infra team)
- Integration testing with sample dataset; latency baseline measurements
- Training: 2 sessions (engineers + ops) + recording + runbook handoff

90 days (cutover & handoff to AM):
- Production load test & final signoff
- Post-cutover monitoring plan and scheduled quality checks (weekly -> monthly)

Proposed kickoff: Wed, Mar 3, 2026 at 10:00 AM PT — works for me. Vivek, can you slot 60–90 minute technical kickoff for integration scoping if that time works?

I'm attaching an editable onboarding task tracker and will convert to a shared project in Monday/Asana once we confirm dates.

Lauren Bishop
Senior Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com | +1 (917) 555-0199

Attachments: MedSync_Onboarding_Tasks.csv

Date: Fri, Feb 27, 2026 at 11:47 AM PST
Subject: Re: Handoff: MedSync Health — Welcome strategy & owner assignment

Thanks Lauren — will plan to join the kickoff. Preliminary technical checklist from my side: 
- Network: customer to provide list of CIDR ranges for allowlist + hub IPs for peering.
- Credentials: service account with contributor role in the resource group OR a collab service principal we can use for provisioning.
- Data migration: sample dataset size ~120GB — need S3/Blob access or secure scp endpoint and ETA for transfer.
- Models: confirm model family / quantization profile we will use in Dedicated (recommended: LlamaX-3b-qa-quant) — want to lock before deployment.
- Monitoring: request initial telemetry keys to integrate with their Datadog account (if provided).

Also putting a quick Miro board link for integration runbook: https://miro.com/app/board/uX_example_medsync

If kickoff is Wed Mar 3 10:00 AM PT, I'll plan for a 90-minute technical block.

—Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Principal Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com

Thanks everyone — sounds good. Confirming next steps and owners here so we have a single source: 

- CS owner: Lauren Bishop (primary) — onboarding plan, runbook, training (owner: Lauren)
- SE lead: Vivek Kulkarni — integration scoping, env provisioning checklist (owner: Vivek)
- Contract / billing lead: Marcus Lin — final invoice schedule and SOW redline follow-up (owner: Marcus)
- Customer kickoff: Wed, Mar 3, 2026 at 10:00 AM PT (90 minutes) — calendar invite to follow.

Action items (by next Tue, Mar 2):
- Marcus: confirm billing milestone and attach final SOW with any redlines (contracts@medsync.co included).
- Vivek: share integration runbook link + list of required access (you already did — thanks).
- Lauren: convert onboarding tasks CSV to shared project and add milestones.
- Monica: prepare SOC2 packet and any compliance call agenda items (if they ask for custom residency language).

Jasmine (sales) will stay on the thread for the first 30 days and help unblock procurement. Derek/Emily — thanks for the quick turnaround; please confirm the kickoff time works for you and whether we should include any additional stakeholders (security/compliance or infra).

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
